entities.summary: Paolo Rocca is an Argentine-Italian businessman, CEO of the Techint Group, which owns Tenaris, Ternium and other companies in the engineering, construction and energy sectors. He is also chairman and CEO of Tenaris, and chairman of Ternium. As of July 2024, Forbes estimated his net worth at US$5.0 billion.
